tools.name: search_functions
tools.description: Search the Kepler scripting reference by name or summary. Returns matching function names with their signature and the number of values they return. An entry carrying a "since" field is not in every build; an empty one is documented but not published yet.

tools.name: get_function
tools.description: Get one function of the Kepler scripting reference: signature, how many values it returns, its category, its examples, and whether it is in a published bot build yet ("availability").

tools.name: list_category
tools.description: List the functions of one category of the Kepler scripting reference. Called without a category, it lists the categories themselves.
